verdict.rationale: Reflect ships a built-in 'AI palette' that can summarize notes, list action items, answer custom prompts, and let users 'chat' with their notes using GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet — a real in-app AI assistant a user can delegate simple analysis/writing tasks to. However, this is limited to text generation/QA over notes rather than broader agentic task execution (no evidence of multi-step autonomous actions, tool use, or task automation beyond note content). Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task delegation, agentic tool-use/actions beyond text Q&A, and independent hands-on verification of the AI assistant's reliability.
